name: doc-pipeline
description: Master orchestrator for the Living Docs pipeline. Coordinates technical documentation updates and visual UI synchronization.

actions.name: sync full pipeline
actions.description: Performs a complete synchronization: checks for stale code, updates text, detects recipe changes, and refreshes UI screenshots. (Trigger: 'run full doc sync', 'sync all docs')

steps.description: Executing the unified Living Docs pipeline.

actions.name: verify pipeline readiness
actions.description: Checks if the project is ready for synchronization (Git status, Python environment, Dev server availability). (Trigger: 'check pipeline status')
